commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' The resulting corner from Xavi Simons (Tottenham) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
90+6' Igor Tudor decides to make a substitution. Richarlison will be replaced by James Rowswell (Tottenham).
90+5' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Xavi Simons (Tottenham) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Tottenham get a corner.
90+1' We are about to witness a substitution. Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) is replacing Alexis Mac Allister.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' 1 - 1 Goal! Randal Kolo Muani tees up Richarlison (Tottenham) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 1:1.

88' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom right corner, but Alisson made an astonishing save!
87' It looks like Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) saw red with that tackle. Chris Kavanagh won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
85' Excellent touch by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
83' Cody Gakpo goes off the pitch and Trey Nyoni (Liverpool) comes on.
83' The corner from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is intercepted by the defence.
82' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Liverpool have a corner.

79' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Guglielmo Vicario has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
77' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
76' Igor Tudor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Callum Olusesi (Tottenham) replacing Djed Spence.
75' Substitution. Mathys Tel walks off the pitch and Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) comes on as a substitute.

74' A neat pass is well received by Djed Spence (Tottenham), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
73' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Mohamed Salah (Liverpool), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the left post.
69' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

68' Richarlison (Tottenham) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Alisson, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
68' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
64' The referee signals a substitution. Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) is brought on as a substitute for Rio Ngumoha.
64' Arne Slot has decided to substitute Florian Wirtz and he is replaced by Curtis Jones (Liverpool).
64' Substitution. Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) has come on for Jeremie Frimpong.
63' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Chris Kavanagh who sees an offensive foul.
58' Liverpool work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

58' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
57' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Tottenham comes to nothing.
56' Here is a change. Souza is going off and Igor Tudor gives the last tactical orders to Xavi Simons (Tottenham).
55' Richarlison (Tottenham) blows a big chance from close range. World class save by the goalkeeper. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Tottenham.
53' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Guglielmo Vicario.
51' Ooh that was close! Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
48' Igor Tudor isn't happy on the touchline after referee Chris Kavanagh shows him a yellow card.
47' Chris Kavanagh interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Kevin Danso (Tottenham).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Chris Kavanagh has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Richarlison (Tottenham) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
45+3' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) is about to take a corner kick.
45+2' Liverpool keep possession of the ball by producing one-two passes, but an opponent steps in and wins the ball.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Richarlison (Tottenham) leaps like a salmon to meet a lofted ball into the box, but his header from near the penalty spot fizzes narrowly wide of the right post.
43' The free kick from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.
43' Chris Kavanagh couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Souza (Tottenham) and blew his whistle. Liverpool are awarded the free kick.
40' Liverpool are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
36' A loose pass is instantly latched onto by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool). He tries his luck from the edge of the box with a measured shot, but it hits the left post and is cleared to safety.
36' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
35' Poor challenge! Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) is penalised for tripping and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle. Liverpool will take a free kick.
34' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
32' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
31' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play. Liverpool win a corner kick.
30' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
28' Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight and sees a foul from Joe Gomez (Liverpool).
26' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
23' The free kick is delivered by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
23' Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) makes a rough challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Liverpool, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
21' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though.
18' 1 - 0 Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) can showcase his brilliant free kick ability, particularly from a distance like this. He hits the ball perfectly and it ends up inside the left post.
17' Archie Gray (Tottenham) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Liverpool.
13' Tottenham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
12' Alisson blocks a long-range effort from Souza (Tottenham) towards the roof of the net. Tottenham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
11' A precise low pass is received by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
10' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
8' Mathys Tel (Tottenham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
6' Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
3' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
2' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is out of play. Tottenham will take a throw-in.
